A '''steel pickaxe''' is the [[Steel equipment|steel]] [[Tools#Pickaxe|pickaxe]], made by smithing an [[Iron Pickaxe|iron pickaxe]] with [[Steel Alloy|steel alloy]]. It mines at speed 8 and has 3000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_pickaxe.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade uses no template: the template slot of the [[Smithing Table|smithing table]] is left empty.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines pickaxe blocks at speed 8.

Its tool rules have no obsidian restriction, so it mines obsidian with drops at its normal speed, although the [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.1-alpha|1.12.1-alpha]] notes say only diamond, electrum and adamant tools can mine obsidian.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_pickaxe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 3 damage with an attack speed of 1.2.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

== Notes ==
* The hand-written tooltip hides the real attributes and shows attack damage 4 (real value 3).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_pickaxe.json}}</ref>
